chip.description: Video controller managing sprites and two 32x32 tilemaps (joinable to 64x32) with all tile/sprite priority resolved on-die, generating 6809-compatible clock and interrupt signals; an evolution of the 005885 (taxonomy V1).
chip.notes: Function from src/mame/konami/k007121.cpp in MAME 0.288 ("It manages sprites and two 32x32 tilemaps ... The chip also generates clock and interrupt signals suitable for a 6809"). Filed video-ppu because one die produces tile layers, sprites and timing (taxonomy §3.1 V1).
